newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinian youth killed in Bethlehem explosion.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian youth killed in Bethlehem explosion.

text.p: A Palestinian youth was killed in PLO-ruled Bethlehem in a bomb explosion on Monday, Israel Radio said.
It quoted Palestinian sources as saying the youth was a member of the Islamist militant group Hamas and that it was being checked whether he was trying to prepare a bomb.
The Israeli army said it was checking the report.
Hamas, which opposes Israeli-Palestinian peace accords, has stood behind suicide attacks in Israel and the Israeli-occupied West Bank and Gaza.
The Palestinian territories have been tense since Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu broke ground on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem in March, sparking weeks of Palestinian unrest.
